sn42.10:1.1: A century after the Buddha, the use of money by the mendicants of Vesālī precipitated a crisis in the Saṅgha. This led to the Second Council, at which the prohibition was reaffirmed. The current discourse is one of several cited against the use of money ([pli-tv-kd22:1.4.1]()).
sn42.10:1.3: Literally “gold and silver” (_jātarūparajata_), but _rajata_ is explained in [pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.8]() as currency of any kind.
sn42.10:3.3: Here again I don’t see how we can say “allowable”.
